title: On the composed Gate 2 batch build (W1-18 legs + v1/contrast-tail together), re-walking the contrast-tail lenses finds the 61 cured signatures absent - no rendered element pairs that foreground/background under 4.5:1 - while the 12 named render-composite residuals still fire, as expected.
author: muse-b3
covers: Fixer muse-b7's section-C contrast-tail builds: five landings on v1/contrast-tail over live main f4f1f77ff (F1 muted text 81dd53aa2 - text-zinc-500/gray-500/gray-600/zinc-600 + placeholder forms to text-lattice-muted, the four muted hex literals to #a1a1aa, 47 lenses / 250 files; F3 saturated fills 2281a21be+dfd6e1300 - bare fill classes paired with light text step one darker, 303 files / 582 lines; F4 neon + F2 slate + F5 emerald text f4bd81991+434c5c8d5 - ActionPanel accent data #a855f7->#c084fc and #ec4899->#f472b6, tint chips to bright steps, text-slate-500/600 to slate-400 / #94a3b8 in conkay/housing/auction/forge/foundry/code, text-emerald-700 to emerald-500 in worldmodel; F6 computed teals 0b2a095bb - bg-teal-500/90 to bg-teal-700/90 in calendar + projects, the measured composites #13a797/#14a797 identified exactly). Premise of record (B7, dossier CLAIMED 2026-11-19T09:00, NOTE 09:20): the 75 tail row-entries are 73 unique signatures, TOKEN 0 / LENS-LOCAL 75 - the W1-18 fix changed no palette value and migrated ~22 shared files, so no tail pair is cured by the batch leg alone. Final accounting: 61 signatures cured (F1 36, F3 9, F6 2, F4 7, F2 6, F5 1; full lists in CHECK-C-CONTRAST-TAIL.md) and 12 residual render-composites with no literal source anywhere in the tree (completed repo-wide search; hunt of record in B7's F6 dossier NOTE) named as expected-to-fire. COMPOSITION REQUIREMENT: F1's text-lattice-muted resolves through MST-W1-18's legs (globals.css --lattice-muted + tailwind lattice.muted), so this recipe replays only on a build containing BOTH v1/shell's W1-18 legs and v1/contrast-tail - the Gate 2 batch as composed under CB-0834. Gate evidence at the fixer seat: four pin suites (muted-f1 51/51, fills-f3 3/3, neon-slate-f4 3/3, computed-f6 3/3) pass on the landed tree and fail on pristine f4f1f77ff as the discriminator records; eslint 0 errors; regression subsets green (203/203, calendar 27/27, 210/210); every landing tree-verified by read-back; server.js untouched in all five landings. NOT claimed: the 12 residuals (they carry their own disposition at the desk; the locating instrument is a browser render at re-capture), any lens outside the premise table's union, and VERIFIED - which waits on the deployed-batch re-walk.
discriminator: Pre-fix, on f4f1f77ff (the capture walk 20261117-080754's own measurements, premise table): muted pairs 2.56-4.44:1, fills 2.9-4.4:1, neon tints 3.76-4.35:1, teal composites 3.0:1 - all under AA 4.5. Pin suites on pristine f4f1f77ff bytes fail as required: contrast-tail-muted-f1 absence legs (48 of 49 lens dirs carry offenders); contrast-tail-fills-f3 absence leg (582 offending lines); contrast-tail-neon-slate-f4 absence legs (accent 120 / chips 285 / slate 101 lines); contrast-tail-computed-f6 absence legs (both buttons carry bg-teal-500/90). On the fixed tree all four suites pass (51 + 3 + 3 + 3 checks).
steps: On the deployed batch build, re-walk the tail lenses (the union of lenses named in the premise table) with the walker's contrast check at desktop + 390px, signed in as the member fixture.
For each of the 61 cured signatures (list in CHECK-C-CONTRAST-TAIL), the signature must be ABSENT: no rendered element pairs that fg/bg under 4.5:1.

The 12 residual signatures (CHECK file, named) are EXPECTED to still fire - they are render-composites with no source anywhere in the tree (hunt of record in the F6 dossier NOTE); they do not fail this recipe and carry their own disposition at the desk.

Read-back: the batch build SHA on /health must contain v1/contrast-tail's head; if the W1-18 legs are absent from the build, F1's rows will read as unstyled-text passes/failures of a different shape - record the composition before scoring.
